title: Writing to a file on a disk
question: The same write, on ext4: is anything written to the disk?
text: Call 2, [write(fd, "hello, ext4\n", 12)](2): [ext4_buffered_write_iter](2:ext4_buffered_write_iter) Into the page cache, as in memory: the page is marked dirty (to be written back). [ext4_da_write_begin](2:ext4_da_write_begin) Delayed allocation: no disk block is chosen for it yet, one is only reserved. Nothing is on the disk yet.
